# Review permissions granted to enterprise applications: a pinned copy of Learn's samples

This folder is an unmodified copy of the Microsoft Learn source page for [Review permissions granted to enterprise applications](https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity/enterprise-apps/manage-application-permissions). It holds Microsoft's Microsoft Entra PowerShell and Microsoft Graph PowerShell scripts that revoke every delegated and application permission granted to one application, and the Microsoft Graph HTTP requests that list and remove them. It comes from [MicrosoftDocs/entra-docs](https://github.com/MicrosoftDocs/entra-docs/blob/7f78b50dce9d8cf119de57cbd6fd66e24a6c58d4/docs/identity/enterprise-apps/manage-application-permissions.md) at commit `7f78b50dce9d8cf119de57cbd6fd66e24a6c58d4` (October 30, 2026); the page last changed on February 19, 2026. The repository's code license (`LICENSE-CODE`) and documentation license (`LICENSE`) are both MIT.

**Why the page, not just the scripts.** The scripts and requests exist only inside this Learn page, in zone pivots. Pinning the page byte for byte keeps the copy checkable against upstream. `examples/non-person-identity/tests/LeastPrivilegeSampleHarness.ps1` extracts the Microsoft Graph PowerShell script and the HTTP requests, unmodified, at test time and runs the script against stand-ins for the cmdlets it calls. Nothing is installed and nothing signs in. The [developer workbook *Building Non-Person Identity*, Chapter 07](../../../docs/project-plans/developer-workbooks/non-person-identity/07-least-privilege-for-service-principals.md) links Learn rather than quoting the page.

**How it stays honest.**

- `snapshot.json` records the upstream repository, path, commit, dates, licenses and the size and SHA-256 of every file here. Each file's git blob hash was checked against the upstream tree at that commit before the manifest was written. `scripts/tests/test_third_party_snapshots.py` fails if any file is changed, added or removed.
- The weekly source watch follows commits to the upstream page (`entra-review-app-permissions-page-commits` in `data/source-watch/feeds.json`) and reports each one in its issue under DW (developer workbooks).
- To move to a newer upstream commit: review the upstream change, copy the page from that commit, regenerate `snapshot.json`, rerun `examples/non-person-identity/tests/NpiLeastPrivilegeSamples.Tests.ps1` and the Chapter 07 labs, and open a pull request. Never edit the files here; changes the program needs go in `examples/non-person-identity`.

These files keep their upstream bytes, line endings included, so the hashes match the upstream commit.
